items.question: Do you remember the first time you saw Sesame Street, and who in your house watched it?

items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost six cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: On July 20, 1969, Apollo 11's Lunar Module Eagle landed on the Moon, and Neil Armstrong took the first steps by a human on its surface.
items.question: Where were you when Neil Armstrong stepped onto the Moon, and who was watching the television with you?
items.source_quote: July 20 – Apollo program Moon landing: At 3:17 pm ET (20:17 UTC) Apollo 11's Lunar Module Eagle lands on the Moon's surface. At 10:56 pm ET (02:56 UTC July 21), an estimated 650 million people worldwide watch in awe as Neil Armstrong takes the first historic steps by a human on the surface.

items.text: The Woodstock Festival was held in upstate New York from August 15 to 18, 1969, featuring some of the era's top rock musicians.
items.question: Do you remember hearing about Woodstock that August, and did you know anyone who went?
items.source_quote: August 15–18 – The Woodstock Festival is held in upstate New York, featuring some of the era's top rock musicians.

items.text: "Sugar, Sugar" by the Archies, a made-up group of characters from the animated television series The Archie Show, reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in September 1969.
items.question: Where were you living when "Sugar, Sugar" by the Archies was on the radio, and who in your house sang along?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1969, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations respectively. During the year, 17 different singles spent time at number one.
In September, "Sugar, Sugar" was the first Hot 100 number one for the Archies. The group was a fictional one consisting of characters from the animated television series The Archie Show
